## Team Vitality — Pre-Match Scouting Summary

**Role Composition**

VIT runs one controller, two duelists, one initiator, and one sentinel. Chronicle and Sayonara are the designated flex players.

**Firepower**

Derke leads at 232 ACS / 1.07 rating across Neon (41%), Jett (34%), and Raze (24%) — a pure duelist specialist with no agent outside that trio. Sayonara sits close behind at 216 ACS / 1.08 rating and is actually the team's highest-rated player by that metric, which is notable given his role is split between duelist and flex duties. His agent spread is genuinely wide: Viper, Sova, Phoenix, and Raze each see meaningful time, meaning he is not a duelist-first player in practice despite the designation.

Chronicle is the third-highest fragger at 207 ACS / 1.05 rating. His pool is dominated by Viper (37%) and Vyse (32%), with Cypher, Chamber, and Killjoy splitting the remainder — he is playing controller-class agents far more than sentinel-class ones despite the sentinel role label. That Viper/Vyse split is worth flagging: he and Sayonara both have Viper in their pools, so map-to-map agent allocation between those two will vary.

Jamppi (182 ACS / 0.95 rating) is the only player below a 1.0 rating. His initiator pool is Fade-heavy (41%), with Kayo and Sova also seeing regular time. PROFEK (179 ACS / 1.0 rating) is heavily committed to Omen (63%), with Harbor as a distant second at 20%.

**Key Structural Note**

The flex usage of both Chronicle and Sayonara means VIT's effective role distribution can shift considerably. Sayonara's Viper and Sova time pulls him toward a controller/initiator function on some maps, and Chronicle's agent pool skews more toward area-denial controllers than traditional sentinel play. Do not assume a rigid two-duelist structure in-game.
